configuration: ./Config.pl -default -v=Empty,OH/BATSRUS,PT/FLEKS; ./Config.pl -o=OH:u=OuterHelio,e=OuterHelio,ng=2,g=4,4,4 -o=PT:lev=5, then make SWMF and make rundir. Decks Param/PARAM.in.test.OHPT.FLEKS.outerhelio.4neu.start, Param/PARAM.in.test.OHPT.FLEKS.outerhelio.4neu.couple unchanged. The couple stage of the upstream four-neutral-fluid outer-heliosphere test: the relaxed solar wind is restarted and OH is coupled to PT/FLEKS, which now carries the particles. This official stage is a human-approved handoff/initialization exception: `Restart.pl` performs the real reload, `DtCouple=0.2 year`, and PT `TimeMax=0.1001 year` (scaled default 0.19 -> 0.019019 year) ends before one periodic interval, so it grades one OH-to-PT handoff rather than three repeated periods. Sustained two-way windows are carried by sibling checks `ohpt-swh` and `ohpt-swhpui`. run.sh runs the start stage first as an ungraded prerequisite. Graded: oh_y0.out.

variant: The OH #SOLARWINDH solar-wind proton density, set in both stage decks, multiplied by 1 + 2e-10 in ic/variant and printed to twelve significant digits -- a relative change far below any physically meaningful difference in the input and an order of magnitude above the last digit the coarsest graded ASCII file carries. It is generic numerical-noise calibration: the two inputs differ by one number, and the spread between the two runs is the floor this pass policy can be held to.
